command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set +e \
  && echo '=== git status (short) ===' \
  && git status --short | head -40 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== git diff --stat (working vs HEAD) ===' \
  && git diff --stat HEAD | tail -5 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== staging all changes ===' \
  && git add -A \
  && echo '=== staged stat ===' \
  && git diff --cached --stat | tail -5 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== creating commit ===' \
  && git -c user.name='vac-web-agent' -c user.email='agent@vac-web.local' commit -m 'feat(R1-R6): close remaining work plan 2026-05-06' -m 'R1: slice 36 trust matrix verify-only' -m 'R2: 4 release.* events with classification + codegen regen' -m 'R3: vac-pr-checklist.mjs + pnpm pr:checklist + dx-tooling.md' -m 'R4: 8-pattern adoption stance section in slice 48' -m 'R5: extension-trust-model.md + ADR 0003 (Phase 1 design)' -m 'R6: tools/perf crate + slo-budgets.yaml + check-slo-measurements.mjs + perf.yml weekly cron (Phase 1 synthetic)' -m 'Closeout: tracker status closed, 6 slice frontmatter R1-R6 closeout markers' 2>&1 | tail -8 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== HEAD commit ===' \
  && git log -1 --oneline \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== re-running verify-codegen gate ===' \
  && bash scripts/verify-codegen.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 \
  && rc=$? \
  && echo "verify-codegen rc=$rc"
